食物吃下去以后去哪儿？: Where does food go after we eat?
一口食物不是掉进肚子就消失了。沿着弯弯的消化管走一趟，再靠近肠壁，看看身体怎样接: A bite of food does not vanish in your tummy. Follow its winding route, then move closer to the intestinal wall to see how your body takes in nutrients.
身体里的旅程 · 消化与吸收: JOURNEYS INSIDE US · DIGESTION AND ABSORPTION
消化管从口腔经食管、胃、小肠、大肠通向肛门，肝脏和胰腺通过导管提供消化液。: The digestive tract runs from the mouth through the esophagus, stomach, small and large intestines to the anus. The liver and pancreas supply digestive fluids through ducts.
小肠管壁收缩推进内容物，放大的绒毛有上皮细胞、毛细血管和中央淋巴管。: Contraction of the small-intestinal wall moves contents. An enlarged villus contains epithelial cells, capillaries and a central lymph vessel.

吞咽后，食管的肌肉依次收缩，把食团推向胃。消化管也会把内容物混合；它不只是一个靠: After swallowing, waves of muscle contraction move the bolus toward the stomach. The digestive tract also mixes its contents; it is more than a bag moved by gravity.
食物不经过肝脏和胰腺: Food does not pass through the liver or pancreas
肝脏制造胆汁，胆囊储存并释放胆汁，胰腺提供消化酶等。它们经导管帮助小肠里的消化，: The liver makes bile, the gallbladder stores and releases it, and the pancreas supplies enzymes and other fluids. Ducts deliver them to help digestion in the small intestine, while food stays in the tract.
营养进去，剩余内容物继续走: Nutrients enter; the remainder moves on
营养经过肠壁细胞进入身体的运输系统。未吸收的内容物继续到大肠，水分继续被吸收；便: Nutrients cross intestinal cells into transport systems. Unabsorbed contents move to the large intestine, where water absorption continues. Stool also contains microbes and shed cells, not only leftover food.
深入看：分解、屏障与两条吸收路线: Explore further: digestion, the barrier and two absorption routes
机械性处理和化学性消化同时协作：咀嚼增加接触面积，胃混合内容物并开始重要的蛋白质: Mechanical processing and chemical digestion cooperate. Chewing increases surface area; the stomach mixes contents and supports important protein digestion; pancreatic and intestinal enzymes continue breaking down digestible macromolecules. Bile salts help emulsify fat and form micelles carrying lipid digestion products; bile is not an enzyme. Real processes overlap rather than waiting for one organ to finish all its work.
绒毛和上皮细胞表面的微绒毛扩大吸收面积，但肠壁不是让食物任意漏过的筛子。葡萄糖等: Villi and the microvilli of epithelial cells increase absorptive area, but the intestinal wall is not an unrestricted sieve. Glucose crosses cell membranes through transport processes and enters capillaries, then can reach the liver through portal blood. Most dietary long-chain lipid products are rebuilt and packaged as chylomicrons in enterocytes, enter villus lacteals, and travel through lymph before reaching blood. Shorter-chain fats have other routes, so this example does not assign all fats to lymph.
一小段小肠的纵切面: A short length of small intestine
管壁收缩，内容物被推进并混合: The wall contracts, moving and mixing contents
绒毛增加与内容物接触的面积: Villi increase the area in contact with contents
先经过上皮细胞，再进入运输通路: Across epithelial cells, then into transport routes
绒毛不是孔洞；细胞构成一道屏障: A villus is not a hole; its cells form a barrier
牙齿和唾液先来帮忙: Teeth and saliva begin the work
食物在口中被咀嚼、与唾液混合；一些淀粉的化学分解已经开始。: Food is chewed and mixed with saliva. Chemical digestion of some starch already begins.
食管把这一口向前送: The esophagus moves the bolus onward
吞咽后，一段接一段的肌肉收缩推动食团到胃。食物走食管，不走呼吸用的气管。: After swallowing, sequential muscle contractions move the bolus toward the stomach. Food follows the esophagus, not the airway.
胃把食物和胃液混合: The stomach mixes food with gastric juice
胃不是把所有营养一次吸走。它混合内容物，与酸和酶一起处理，再逐渐送往小肠。: The stomach does not absorb all the nutrients at once. It mixes contents with acid and enzymes, then gradually releases them into the small intestine.
小肠继续分解，也接过营养: The small intestine digests and absorbs
胆汁和胰液帮助消化。内容物中的营养经过肠壁细胞，再进入血液或淋巴；放大绒毛看得更: Bile and pancreatic juice support digestion. Nutrients cross intestinal cells before entering blood or lymph. Enlarge a villus for a closer look.
大肠继续吸水，留下的形成便便: The colon absorbs more water; the remainder forms stool
葡萄糖经过细胞，进入血液: Glucose crosses cells and enters blood
金色小点先经过上皮，再到红色毛细血管。葡萄糖的转运由膜上的蛋白参与，并不是整块食: Gold dots first cross the epithelium, then reach red capillaries. Membrane proteins help transport glucose; whole food pieces do not leak through gaps.
脂肪产物先进入细胞，再被包装: Lipid products enter cells, then are packaged
多数膳食长链脂肪经消化、吸收后，在细胞里重新包装成乳糜微粒，进入绿色淋巴管，后来: After digestion and uptake, most dietary long-chain fats are repackaged as chylomicrons inside cells. They enter the green lymph vessel and reach blood later.
金褐色小块表示一批食物的去向，不表示真实大小。小肠吸收大部分营养和水；大肠继续吸: Gold-brown pieces follow one illustrative cohort, not its true size. The small intestine absorbs most nutrients and water; the colon continues absorption of remaining water and electrolytes.
小肠已吸收大部分水分。大肠继续吸收剩余的水和电解质，粪便进入直肠暂存，最后通过肛: The small intestine has already absorbed most water. The colon continues to absorb remaining water and electrolytes. Stool is stored in the rectum, then leaves through the anus.

Routes are simplified and time is compressed; particle counts do not represent composition or absorption efficiency. Blue water dots appear in the villus and colon: most water is absorbed in the small intestine, with further water and electrolyte absorption in the colon. This page cannot estimate digestion time, disease or individual nutritional needs.
